run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
parse_pump_ast: parse a Pump source text string into an AST using ParseToAST for meta programming
convert_pump_source: convert Pump source text to generated output code using ConvertFromPumpSource
beautify_code: beautify generated code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters using BeautifyCode
tokenize_pump: tokenize Pump source text into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
